result.reason: The operative grant covers Company affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, is royalty-free, perpetual and irrevocable, and is transferable to an M&A successor. It therefore substantially reaches the preferred position and, at minimum, exceeds the fallback; subscription termination is inapplicable. Contractor’s ownership and the existing use limitation remain intact. However, adding “worldwide” and relocating paragraph (c) were not required by the playbook, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Drafting is generally sound but retains the malformed phrase “create, derivative version” and could state the permitted derivative-works right more professionally.
